title: Test a Vue Component with Vue Test Utils
description: Mount a component, interact with it, and write assertions.
problemStatement: ## Problem Statement Given a `Counter.vue` component: ```vue ``` Write tests using Vue Test Utils and Vitest to verify: - The component renders the initial count correctly. - Clicking the increment button increases the count. - Clicking the decrement button decreases the count. - Clicking the reset button resets the count to the initial value. - The decrement button can go below zero (no restriction). Use `data-test` attributes to select elements. **Bonus**: Test that the component updates the DOM as expected after each action.
hints:
Use `mount` to render the component.
    Pass `props: { initial: 5 }` if needed.
    Use `wrapper.find('[data-test="increment"]')` to locate buttons.
    Use `await` after `trigger` to wait for DOM updates.
    Check the text of the `[data-test="count"]` element.
expectedOutput: A test file that passes all test cases.
